import json
from eval_event_extraction import evaluate_document, compute_prf, normalize_text

data = [json.loads(l) for l in open('outputs/wikievents_mistral_unconstrained_full.jsonl')]

# Aggregate
all_gold_ent, all_pred_ent = set(), set()
all_gold_trig, all_pred_trig = set(), set()
all_gold_arg, all_pred_arg = set(), set()
parse_success = 0
total = len(data)

for i, rec in enumerate(data):
    parsed = rec.get('parsed_output')
    if parsed is None:
        continue
    if isinstance(parsed, list):
        parsed = {'events': parsed, 'entities': []}
    parse_success += 1
    
    gold_entities = rec.get('gold_entities', [])
    gold_events = rec.get('gold_events', [])
    
    # Entity F1
    for e in gold_entities:
        all_gold_ent.add((i, normalize_text(e['text']), e.get('type','')))
    for e in parsed.get('entities', []):
        all_pred_ent.add((i, normalize_text(e['text']), e.get('type','')))
    
    # Trigger F1
    for ev in gold_events:
        t = ev.get('trigger','')
        all_gold_trig.add((i, normalize_text(t), ev.get('event_type','')))
    for ev in parsed.get('events', []):
        t = ev.get('trigger','')
        all_pred_trig.add((i, normalize_text(t), ev.get('event_type','')))
    
    # Argument F1
    for ev in gold_events:
        t = ev.get('trigger','')
        et = ev.get('event_type','')
        for arg in ev.get('arguments', []):
            all_gold_arg.add((i, normalize_text(t), et, normalize_text(arg['text']), arg['role']))
    for ev in parsed.get('events', []):
        t = ev.get('trigger','')
        et = ev.get('event_type','')
        for arg in ev.get('arguments', []):
            all_pred_arg.add((i, normalize_text(t), et, normalize_text(arg.get('text','')), arg.get('role','')))

ent_r = compute_prf(all_gold_ent, all_pred_ent)
trig_r = compute_prf(all_gold_trig, all_pred_trig)
arg_r = compute_prf(all_gold_arg, all_pred_arg)

print(f'Parse Success: {parse_success}/{total} ({100*parse_success/total:.1f}%)')
print(f'Entity F1: {ent_r[\"f1\"]:.4f} (P={ent_r[\"precision\"]:.4f}, R={ent_r[\"recall\"]:.4f})')
print(f'Trigger F1: {trig_r[\"f1\"]:.4f} (P={trig_r[\"precision\"]:.4f}, R={trig_r[\"recall\"]:.4f})')
print(f'Argument F1: {arg_r[\"f1\"]:.4f} (P={arg_r[\"precision\"]:.4f}, R={arg_r[\"recall\"]:.4f})')
"
